points.description: States that the infix expression is first converted to postfix form (postfix/reverse Polish notation), and then the postfix expression is evaluated.
points.partial_credit: 2 marks if only one stage is given clearly (only conversion to postfix, or only evaluating a postfix expression) or the idea is stated vaguely (e.g. 'converted to another form then evaluated').

points.description: Gives the correct order of the two steps: conversion to postfix comes first, evaluation of the postfix expression follows.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying infix is converted to postfix and the postfix is then evaluated, in any wording, even briefly. Part marks if only one of the two stages is stated or the answer is vague about the intermediate form. Give no marks for answers that only describe operator precedence or brackets in general without mentioning postfix, or that name a wrong form such as prefix only.
